# Concrete rounded C0/C2 completed-call service

For the literal PR4743 tensor calls, an explicit nearest-even fixed-grid
butterfly implementation meets a requested completed-call tolerance rho=2^-q
with grid bits **g=q+ceil(f/2)+1**. The proof includes every internal numerator,
actual stored inputs, adjoints, two arbitrary dirty banks, all four forward/reverse
ports and a conservative signed-word width. No freely chosen error is injected.

[PROOF.md](PROOF.md) supplies the all-width recurrence, source-ordered substitution,
work/storage bill and limits. This direct backend costs O(f8^f), including every
paid-call butterfly; it does not inherit an accelerated recursive tariff and
makes no new κ or selected-frontier claim.

```
python3 -I -W error -B research/native-rounded-butterfly-contract/verify.py
python3 -I -W error -O -B research/native-rounded-butterfly-contract/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-rounded-butterfly-contract
```

The verifier uses authenticated predecessor sparse-matrix arithmetic as an exact
oracle, and a new integer production path with literal phases and rounding. It
checks C0/C2 in both directions at widths1/2/3, all twelve actual port cases,
input quantization, every completed-call defect against actual stored inputs,
signed ties, nonzero rounding and overflow/axis/adjoint controls. RESULT is
recomputed and compared. The explicit half-grid unit-input loss also shows why
abstract independent error balls need not describe realizable rounding patterns.

This answers the concrete implementation question left by our
`native-error-channel-amplification`; it does not repeat its sharp external norm
calculation. It differs from the already completed QQ16 F0 native rounding
witness, which uses significand rounding on a different complete word.

Canonical source base32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04, priority7;
[Discussion5475](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5475).
The retained selected5413 frontier is unchanged. Root coordinated fresh live
handoff/PR/Discussion overlap before assignment.

## Open next questions

- Can a source-compatible accelerated recursive Gaussian implementation satisfy
  the same internal contract with a better full work/precision bill? Begin with
  one actual recursive child, preserving every rounded cut and scratch return.
  The direct O(fN) algorithm here supplies accuracy, not that acceleration.
- Which sharp external fault patterns can actually be generated by deterministic
  rounded whole ports? Start from the proved one-butterfly parity constraint.
  The independent-ball upper bound does not establish attainability.
